high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The room features a large window that offers a view of an urban landscape, suggesting the room is located in a high-rise building. The natural light streaming through the window enhances the brightness of the space. The furniture includes a wooden sofa set with a matching coffee table. The sofa set has a combination of light beige upholstery and dark wood frames, creating a warm and harmonious color scheme. The sofa set is adorned with yellow cushions, adding a pop of color to the otherwise neutral palette.
